scripts.build: node scripts/doc-dates.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/docs/prerender.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender-docs.mjs && node scripts/package-skill.mjs
scripts.video: remotion render remotion/index.ts Demo public/media/demo.mp4 --public-dir=remotion/public --codec=h264 --crf=24 && remotion still remotion/index.ts Demo public/media/demo-poster.jpg --public-dir=remotion/public --frame=1030 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=85
scripts.promo: python3 remotion/audio/sfx.py && python3 remotion/audio/music.py && remotion render remotion/index.ts Promo out/promo-unmastered.mp4 --public-dir=remotion/public --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k && remotion/audio/master.sh out/promo-unmastered.mp4 out/opentraffic-promo.mp4
scripts.sign-in: vite build --ssr src/sign-in/render.tsx --outDir dist-sign-in && node scripts/build-sign-in.mjs
